designationHistory.indexText: The refuge was established in 1905 as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife, especially the herring gull, which had large nesting colonies on the islands.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
